sentences.l1: People yawn when they are tired.

sentences.l2: 打哈欠时，嘴巴张得很大，会吸进很多空气。
sentences.l1: When yawning, the mouth opens very wide and takes in a lot of air.
This is a function of the body.

sentences.l2: 科学家研究这个现象，这叫生物学。
sentences.l1: Scientists study this phenomenon, and this is called biology.

sentences.l2: 打哈欠可能和大脑温度有关。
sentences.l1: Yawning may be related to brain temperature.

sentences.l2: 大脑太热时，打哈欠能让它变凉一点。
sentences.l1: When the brain is too hot, yawning can make it a little cooler.

sentences.l2: 神经学是研究大脑和神经的科学。
sentences.l1: Neurology is the science that studies the brain and nerves.

sentences.l2: 神经学发现，人看到别人打哈欠，自己也会想打。
sentences.l1: Neurology has found that when people see others yawn, they want to yawn too.

sentences.l2: 这就是打哈欠的传染性。
sentences.l1: This is the contagiousness of yawning.

sentences.l2: 你在教室里看到同学打哈欠，你可能马上也想打。
sentences.l1: If you see a classmate yawn in the classroom, you may want to yawn right away too.

sentences.l2: 打哈欠不是因为懒，是身体需要。
sentences.l1: Yawning is not because of laziness, but because the body needs it.
We should listen to our bodies.

sentences.l2: 困了就打哈欠，然后去睡觉。
sentences.l1: When sleepy, yawn, and then go to sleep.
